section: E02 — Defensive basics and Combat Achievements

section: E03 — Zulrah: controlled supply and unique farm
text: Make sure you have enough teleports to Zulrah and back to a bank.

section: E03 — Zulrah: controlled supply and unique farm
text: Test the full rotation on a non-HCIM account before you start on your Hardcore.

section: E03 — Zulrah: controlled supply and unique farm
text: Start with one kill per trip instead of maximising kills per hour.

section: E03 — Zulrah: controlled supply and unique farm
text: Set a minimum HP before you enter that is above the highest possible combined damage.

text: Leave the trip immediately when you lose control of venom, prayer, food or the rotation.

section: E03 — Zulrah: controlled supply and unique farm
text: Treat the uniques as optional progress and move to another upgrade if RNG holds you back.

text: Set up your Slayer helmet, bonecrusher and ash sanctifier where useful, and your default prayer or safespot preset.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Make the whip upgrade around 85 Slayer if it is available to you.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Plan the trident upgrade around the required Slayer level and stock runes or charges.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Save cannonballs or burst and barrage runes for the tasks where they really save time.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Farm zenyte shards at demonic gorillas once you are prepared for their prayer switches.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Never take a Wilderness task unless you explicitly choose to risk your status.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Build your block and skip list from the points you actually have and your own preference.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Process herb and seed drops before the next long Slayer session.

section: E04 — Slayer 85–95: systematic upgrades
text: Work towards the 93 and 95 Slayer unlocks while leaving room for gear and quest detours.

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips
text: Check the boss-specific entry requirements and the god items you need for faction protection.

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips
text: Check your killcount, ecumenical keys and route requirements for the boss you chose.

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips
text: Practise the rhythm between boss and minions with one safe test kill.

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips
text: Stop when your damage pattern or run energy is different from your practised route.

section: E05 — God Wars Dungeon: preparation trips
text: Only farm for concrete upgrades such as armour or a specific weapon, and reassess after every session.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Check Song of the Elves and the real requirements for the route you choose.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Decide beforehand whether you really need an enhanced crystal weapon seed for your next content.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Practise full Corrupted Gauntlet runs on a non-HCIM account until both prep and boss are consistent.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Decide before every run which prep quality you accept as a minimum.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Do not enter the boss room when time, food or armour is below your minimum.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Practise the last-phase tornado movement and the prayer and audio cues in particular.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Consider a ranged alternative on purpose if keeping your HCIM status is your top priority.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Work out your total crystal shard needs before you start new grinds.

section: E06 — Bowfa crossroads: Gauntlet or an alternative
text: Adjust your route after new gear drops; not every end boss needs a Bowfa.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Decide your goal: prayer scrolls, gear or practice for the later raids.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Bring suitable melee, ranged and magic switches for the raid.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Practise scouting or learn the fixed raid layout you want to run.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Learn the Olm roles at a calm pace; a low first point score is fine.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Do your first runs with experienced players who communicate clearly.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Note which mechanics you regularly miss and practise them on purpose in the next runs.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: Farm until you have the prayer scrolls you want, or move on when another unlock helps you more.

section: E07 — Chambers of Xeric: the first raid
text: After every new prayer unlock, check whether your DPS, defence style or gear priorities change.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Check Beneath Cursed Sands and your access to the raid.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Make an exact loadout per room plus food, restores and special attacks.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Learn Akkha, Kephri, Ba-Ba and Zebak one by one on another account.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Learn the Wardens completely, including the different phases and the enrage.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Pick a low raid level you can repeat reliably and do not scale up after one successful run.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Resist adding invocations for small reward gains.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Have an exit plan for connection problems or running low on supplies.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Repeat runs until you get the fang or the uniques you want; there is no guaranteed drop timing.

section: E08 — Tombs of Amascut: fang and shadow route
text: Recalculate your next boss route with your new weapon afterwards.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Find a reliable team that agrees on roles and calls beforehand.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Practise Verzik and the other rooms on a normal account until no mechanic is new to you.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Learn the safe room order, positions and calls per encounter.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Agree who takes which role or aggro and what happens after a disconnect.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Make a supply budget per room and do not burn all restores in the first half.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Do a full group dry run before your Hardcore joins.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Stop after a failed practice run or trip to analyse the mistakes instead of trying again straight away.

section: E09 — Theatre of Blood: fixed team training
text: Treat the avernic defender, Sanguinesti staff, Ghrazi rapier and Scythe of vitur as goals, not guaranteed drops.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Make sure you understand the current HCIM death rules of the specific activity.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Learn ranged and magic prayer flicking in the Fight Caves and harder PvM content.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Check your gear and supplies for dozens of waves, not only the final boss.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Practise difficult safespots and line-of-sight patterns beforehand.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Inferno: build a repeatable route to Zuk with safe corner and shield movement.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Colosseum: choose waves and modifiers on purpose and practise on a non-HCIM account.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Skip a dangerous run when you have no experience with that encounter.

section: E10 — Inferno and Fortis Colosseum
text: Treat the Infernal cape and Dizana's quiver as optional achievements, separate from your maxing route.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Check the quest requirements and your effective combat stats.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Pick one boss and study its full move set, including unexpected specials.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Write down the exact safe tiles if you follow a guide with position advice.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Build a gear preset and bank trip for that one boss.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Do a test run on a normal account and test the teleport and log-out restrictions.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Farm in short sessions with clear stop conditions.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Add the uniques you get to your gear ladder without counting on fast RNG.

section: E11 — Desert Treasure II and other late bosses
text: Adjust your PvM route as soon as you get a new weapon or armour set.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Check the latest mechanics and changes, because these encounters are relatively new.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Decide on a solo, duo or group approach and what that does to the risk.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Practise every relevant mechanic on a non-HCIM account.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Write down which supply or damage checks are required.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Aim for one controlled first win or a safe claim the first time, not a killcount rush.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Stop at any mechanic that behaves differently from your practice.

section: E12 — Yama, Doom of Mokhaiotl and other newer PvM
text: Only then decide whether a specific drop is worth it for your account.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Complete While Guthix Sleeps and check every other current entry requirement; the raid is in the Chasm of Tears.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Every death in The Fractured Archive is a dangerous death that costs your Hardcore status.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: A run has five of its eight bosses: Archive Guardian first, then Ezekiel or Bork and the Smorks, Moia or Dreadnoth the Jellied, The Dagon'hai or Xarth, and Ocellus last.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Bosses scale to the party size with a minimum of two players, so solo runs are tuned like a duo.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Build a team on a normal account that knows every boss and the final fight.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Train each boss separately until you recognise its routes and overlapping damage patterns.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Agree on team roles, item swaps, recovery, communication and what to do after a disconnect.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Budget supplies for the whole run, not for one room.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Drop this raid from your active route if keeping your status is your highest priority.

section: E13 — The Fractured Archive: the fourth raid (2026)
text: Only chase the uniques (Horn of Bran for Zeal, Zorya's tome, Rondache, Ascension crossbows, Obligator) when they clearly improve your next goals.

section: E14 — Elite diaries, Sailing and the max cape
text: Make a checklist of every missing elite diary skill and quest requirement.

section: E14 — Elite diaries, Sailing and the max cape
text: Pick one active skill for XP and one passive skill for dailies and runs every week.

text: Keep Herblore moving with herb runs, contracts and useful drops.

section: E14 — Elite diaries, Sailing and the max cape
text: Keep Farming moving with tree, fruit tree and herb contract rotations.

text: Spread Construction and Crafting over your real supply of materials.

text: Plan Smithing, Mining, Runecraft, Agility and Sailing separately based on your materials and unlocks.

section: E14 — Elite diaries, Sailing and the max cape

section: E14 — Elite diaries, Sailing and the max cape
text: Keep a separate list of optional Collection Log and Combat Achievement goals.

text: The Mad Angel drops the Hallowfell (75 Attack), which hits up to three targets.

section: E15 — New 2026 content in recommended order

section: E15 — New 2026 content in recommended order

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?

text: Make sure you can combine dragon scimitar, dragon defender, Barrows gloves, fighter torso and helm of neitiznot into one standard melee preset.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Collect prayer armour such as proselyte after its quest chain and wear it on Slayer or long tasks instead of the torso when Prayer matters more.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Work on a berserker ring at Dagannoth Rex only if you can do it safely; the way to the Dagannoth Kings and wrong prayers are dangerous, and it is not a required early upgrade.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Train to the levels for the zombie axe and farm it once you handle the armoured zombies comfortably; it is a strong slash and crush option before or next to the whip.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Unlock Perilous Moons through its quest and study the Neypotzli boss mechanics; it is DANGEROUS for an HCIM despite the supplies inside the complex.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Treat the Eclipse atlatl, Blood moon armour and dual macuahuitl as possible midgame upgrades, but never worth an unprepared HCIM death.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Only farm the Royal Titans when the mechanics of both titans, the arena and your escape plan are clear; their drops can be a valuable newer gear option.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11A — Melee and armour
text: Build a tank or panic preset with more Defence, HP and Prayer; your first trip to risky content does not automatically use your highest DPS setup.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11B — Ranged: from budget to top
text: Use a rune crossbow with useful bolts or a magic shortbow (i) as a temporary ranged setup, with Ava's device and a steady ammo supply.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11B — Ranged: from budget to top
text: Use blessed d'hide from clues or other midgame armour, and never let "perfect ranger boots" block your progress.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11B — Ranged: from budget to top
text: Look at the sunlight hunter's crossbow and the Eclipse atlatl as routes when you are not going to risk the Bowfa straight away.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11B — Ranged: from budget to top
text: Work to 75–85 Ranged before the harder bosses; 90+ is a comfortable goal for endgame PvM.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11B — Ranged: from budget to top
text: If you go for the Bowfa, an enhanced crystal weapon seed plus crystal armour is the end goal of your Gauntlet route (chapter 12).

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Use Iban's staff (u) for early single-target Magic where the spell works well.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Farm a warped sceptre or another midgame staff when it fits your Magic level and Slayer access.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Unlock Ancient Magicks through Desert Treasure I once you can do the quest safely; ice burst and barrage are very strong on some Slayer tasks.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Work to 87 Slayer for cave kraken and eventually a trident of the seas.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Farm Zulrah later for a magic fang and possibly a toxic trident, but only when you fully control the danger of that fight.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Get and upgrade a mage cape and robes; accuracy, defence and sustain matter more than a perfect-looking set.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11C — Magic: from Iban to raid-ready
text: Get 90+ Magic for comfortable multi-style PvM and practise your spellbook and staff swaps in safe CoX encounters.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?

text: Unlock and use a rune pouch as soon as you can get one in a way that suits you; it saves inventory space when bossing.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11D — Core accessories
text: Work on dragon boots once your Slayer level and drops allow it; other boots from clues or bosses are optional.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11D — Core accessories
text: Save onyx and zenyte shards for valuable jewellery once your Crafting is high enough to make it.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11D — Core accessories
text: Put the amulet of torture, necklace of anguish, tormented bracelet and ring of suffering on your long-term list, but grind them in the order of your current PvM needs.

chapter: 11. Midgame gear ladder: which upgrades first?
section: 11D — Core accessories
text: Checkpoint: a solid melee, ranged and magic preset in your bank, each with one defensive variant.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12A — Decide before you enter the portal
text: Choose: A. postpone the Gauntlet and follow an alternative ranged progression, or B. commit to the Bowfa with the best preparation you can get.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12A — Decide before you enter the portal
text: For route B, train to very comfortable stats, ideally about 85–90+ Ranged, 85–90+ Magic and 80+ Defence (guidelines, not hard requirements).

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12A — Decide before you enter the portal
text: Learn the rules: resource rooms, minibosses, demi-bosses, armour crafting, weapons, potions, food, the prep timer and the Hunllef arena.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12A — Decide before you enter the portal
text: Practise on a non-HCIM account when possible; it does not make your first real attempt risk-free, but basic mistakes will not cost your only life.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12A — Decide before you enter the portal
text: Focus on tornado movement, floor patterns, prayer switching and weapon switching, and train the reflex to dodge first and deal damage second.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Do not speedrun on your HCIM: pick a conservative prep with tier 2 armour if possible, a good weapon combination and enough food and potions.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Gather the required resources in one route, and leave the dungeon instead of forcing a weak attempt when bad room layouts ruin your prep.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: During the Hunllef, watch the boss rather than your DPS, keep your HP above a wide personal safety margin and never skip a prayer switch for damage.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Practise the normal Gauntlet first if you choose the risk; it is still a dangerous death even though the mechanics are easier.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Only go to the Corrupted Gauntlet after long, consistent experience with the mechanics and a proven prep strategy.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: List the enhanced crystal weapon seed as the main drop and crystal armour seeds as secondary drops, and expect RNG instead of an exact drop count.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Craft the Bow of Faerdhinen and the crystal armour pieces you need once you have the seeds, shards and Crafting and Smithing levels.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: Manage crystal shards for repairs, charges and other useful Prifddinas systems, and check the current material cost before you corrupt the bow.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12B — Conservative HCIM prep
text: If you do not get a Bowfa and the risk gets too high, stop: sometimes the right HCIM strategy is to play on without the item.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12C — Route without a Bowfa
text: Use the rune crossbow, sunlight hunter's crossbow or Eclipse atlatl where their strengths fit, and improve Ranged and Prayer first.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12C — Route without a Bowfa
text: Learn Chambers of Xeric: an HCIM-safe raid with useful PvM experience and potentially strong unique drops.

chapter: 12. The most dangerous midgame crossroads: Normal/Corrupted Gauntlet → Bowfa
section: 12C — Route without a Bowfa
text: Invest in safe training, Slayer, better food and jewellery; you can still choose the Bowfa later when your mechanics are stronger.

section: 15A — First PvM upgrades

section: 15A — First PvM upgrades

section: 15A — First PvM upgrades

section: 15B — The first big unique drops

section: 15B — The first big unique drops
text: Only keep farming Zulrah while the risk is acceptable; the magic fang, tanzanite fang and serpentine visage are strong, but no drop is guaranteed.

section: 15B — The first big unique drops

section: 15B — The first big unique drops

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon

section: 15C — God Wars Dungeon
text: Nex only at very high combat and gear levels, with team knowledge and a plan for minions and specials, because one wrong team call can cost your HCIM.

section: 15D — Varlamore and later boss chains

section: 15D — Varlamore and later boss chains

section: 15D — Varlamore and later boss chains

section: 15D — Varlamore and later boss chains
